summary: Compare bounded implementations through normalized contracts, traces, state and effect observations, minimized divergences, and explicit unknowns.
triggers: A rewrite or migration needs behavioral comparison beyond a textual diff.
Two implementations may differ in errors, state transitions, ordering, or side effects.
A semantic divergence needs a minimized reproducible fixture.
antiTriggers: Declare arbitrary programs equivalent from matching source shape.
Ignore environment or dependency differences that affect behavior.
Execute untrusted code without an appropriate sandbox.

provenance.note: Method source read in full and independently rewritten for portable product use; the historical file remains unchanged.
Comparable environment, trace, classification, minimization, sandbox, and unknown-region semantics informed the rewrite; no source prose was copied.
Ownership and evidence boundaries were consulted; no equivalence result is asserted.
